# Aso-4 fallout reconstruction

The accepted dataset contains 83 exact measurements, 3 lower bounds and 1 upper bound. The regional fits share an observation hull of 3,482,991 km². [Accepted thickness CSV](../../data/eruptions/Aso-4_reviewed.csv) · [Row-level source audit](../../data/audits/Aso-4/README.md)

## Bulk fallout volume

| Model | Area | Volume summary (km³) | Conditional 95% volume interval (km³) |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| [Directional ensemble](results/directional/README.md) | Whole Earth | Median-map integral **740.0** · complete-field median 882.7 | 397.5–2,931.7 |
| [Spherical mixture](results/spherical-mixture/README.md) | Whole Earth | Posterior median **1,466.0** | 501.0–44,172.9 |
| GP ensemble | Observation hull | Expected **202.65** | 155.87–266.97 |
| Cubic spline | Observation hull | Expected **248.15** | 168.43–452.02 |

The directional interval summarizes complete simulated deposits. Measured interpolation triangles hold **3.3%** of the central directional map’s volume. The regional intervals condition on the fitted settings. [Paired regional maps and held-out tests](results/README.md)

![Regional and whole-Earth volumes, with matched geographic prediction scores for Aso-4](results/overview.png)

## Evidence and limitations

The reviewed input corrects two cruise locations and retains the Biwa source conflict and the Hokkaido erosion interpretation. The nearest accepted site is 88 km from the vent. The southeast, south and west have two, two and zero exact measurements. The large spherical-mixture total remains questioned. Omitting all 28 source-labelled marine records raises its median to about 3,184 km³. A regional deletion also makes the spline partial volume unstable. [Source, geometry and influence experiments](../../comparisons/aso-4-audit/README.md)

The standard local-support footprint covers 711,348 km². No complete isopach band passed the support and deletion checks. [Support map, partial volumes and rejected contours](results/support/README.md)

# B-Tm fallout reconstruction

The accepted dataset contains 84 exact measurements. The regional fits share an observation hull of 963,645 km². [Accepted thickness CSV](../../data/eruptions/B-Tm_tephra.csv) · [Input provenance](../../data/eruptions/README.md)

## Bulk fallout volume

| Model | Area | Volume summary (km³) | Conditional 95% volume interval (km³) |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| [Directional ensemble](results/directional/README.md) | Whole Earth | Median-map integral **59.3** · complete-field median 71.0 | 42.2–410.0 |
| [Spherical mixture](results/spherical-mixture/README.md) | Whole Earth | Posterior median **106.3** | 53.2–2,159.2 |
| GP ensemble | Observation hull | Expected **30.46** | 23.22–41.28 |
| Cubic spline | Observation hull | Expected **40.16** | 22.81–86.18 |

The directional interval summarizes complete simulated deposits. Measured interpolation triangles hold **3.6%** of the central directional map’s volume. The regional intervals condition on the fitted settings. [Paired regional maps and held-out tests](results/README.md)

![Regional and whole-Earth volumes, with matched geographic prediction scores for B-Tm](results/overview.png)

## Evidence and limitations

The principal calculation treats all 84 supplied thicknesses as exact. The spherical mixture uses source-focused fans. A recovered source table identifies an upper bound at Suigetsu and unquantified cryptotephra at Kushu. The two-site sensitivity gives a spherical-mixture median of about 100 km³. One or more spherical prior refits carry a numerical warning. [Source review and two-site sensitivity](../../comparisons/source-revision/btm-input-sensitivity/README.md)

The standard local-support footprint covers 52,431 km². No complete isopach band passed the support and deletion checks. [Support map, partial volumes and rejected contours](results/support/README.md)

# Minoan fallout reconstruction

The accepted dataset contains 92 exact measurements and 9 lower bounds. The regional fits share an observation hull of 760,879 km². [Accepted thickness CSV](../../data/eruptions/Minoan_tephra.csv) · [Row-level source audit](../../data/audits/Minoan/README.md)

## Bulk fallout volume

| Model | Area | Volume summary (km³) | Conditional 95% volume interval (km³) |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| [Directional ensemble](results/directional/README.md) | Whole Earth | Median-map integral **33.7** · complete-field median 42.0 | 26.6–129.1 |
| [Spherical mixture](results/spherical-mixture/README.md) | Whole Earth | Posterior median **46.0** | 28.1–2,529.2 |
| GP ensemble | Observation hull | Expected **27.21** | 18.21–40.34 |
| Cubic spline | Observation hull | Expected **24.78** | 24.79–25.00 |

The directional interval summarizes complete simulated deposits. Measured interpolation triangles hold **7.3%** of the central directional map’s volume. The spline’s narrow interval conditions on its fitted trend. Its field draws used a coarser integration grid than the expected-volume calculation, which puts the reported mean just below that interval. [Paired regional maps and held-out tests](results/README.md)

![Regional and whole-Earth volumes, with matched geographic prediction scores for Minoan](results/overview.png)

## Evidence and limitations

The input combines all accepted Plinian and co-ignimbrite airborne fallout fans in one deposit. Nine totals reported with a greater-than sign enter as lower bounds. The reported volumes exclude ignimbrite flow deposits.

The standard local-support footprint covers 41,066 km². No complete isopach band passed the support and deletion checks. [Support map, partial volumes and rejected contours](results/support/README.md)
